metadata.malware_name: INV-2026-084 Sliver and Metasploit toolkit on an open-directory operator host
metadata.family: Sliver implants (8 builds, 7 dial the case host, 1 internal TCP pivot), Metasploit Meterpreter stagers (6), PowerShell C2 scripts
metadata.notes: Pre-publication. Operator-side indicators only. No victim address, host name, account, credential, organisation name or abbreviation is in this feed. Network values are not defanged (machine-readable). Hash-only rows are marked as listed, not computed. Not checked: operator reuse of any hash, key or UUID on other hosts; full values of the age keys of the garbled builds; the Npcap vendor-style certificate files.

tls_certificates.context: Cloudflare Origin Certificate served by the case host, SAN cytomate.xyz and *.cytomate.xyz (a pivot for a certificate search) Pivot key: pivot only; a VT certificate search on it returned 0 but the VT modifier control failed (NOT CHECKED). Hunt.io search 2026-11-17: no other IP presents this certificate (Joseph's account, bounded by Hunt.io's coverage); Hunt.io shows the case host serving it on 443 from 2026-09-14 to 2026-10-27 (Corrected 2026-11-17, T-0646, Hunt.io GUI review)

Sliver mTLS CA certificate (self-signed, empty subject, P-384) shared by sp.exe, sliver.exe, u131.exe, u237.exe, u218.exe; NotBefore 2025-10-11 is a floor only (CA created between 2025-10-11 and 2026-10-10) Pivot key: pivot key for other servers of the same Sliver instance; any listener presenting a certificate from this CA is the same server. Hunt.io search 2026-11-17 (45-day window): 1 hit, the case host only, so no second server is found in that window (bounded negative; longer window NOT CHECKED) (Corrected 2026-11-17, T-0646, Hunt.io GUI review)
